CT RISE Network | Junior Software Developer | REMOTE (US) | Nonprofit | Full-Time

CT RISE Network is a Connecticut-based nonprofit improving educational outcomes through data tools and technology that support schools and educators.

We’re hiring a Junior Software Developer to help design, build, and ship new features across our product ecosystem. You’ll work across frontend, backend, and cloud systems; build RESTful APIs and modern web applications; participate in code reviews; and receive mentorship while contributing to secure, scalable solutions used by real educators.

Great benefits and flexible work schedule. A good opportunity for someone looking to work at a mission driven organization making a difference in schools.

Apply here: https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/...
